title: How the huge data center buildout is heating up local politics in US towns across red and blue states on issues like water, electricity, and noise (Evan Halper/Washington Post)
summary: Evan Halper / Washington Post: How the huge data center buildout is heating up local politics in US towns across red and blue states on issues like water, electricity, and noise — As the buildout of AI infrastructure alarms communities, it is fast emerging as a potent electoral issue across the political divide.
